title: US-04: As a user, I want to receive an in-app notification when the status of my booking changes.
body:
**Epic:** E2 · **Points:** 3 · **Priority:** Must · **Dependencies:** US-02

**User story**
As a user, I want to receive an in-app notification when the status of my booking changes.

**Acceptance criteria**
A notification is created for the affected user on approval, rejection, cancellation, redirection and training authorization; GET /notifications returns only the caller's own notifications, newest first; a failure to create a notification is logged and does not roll back the operation.

**Owner:** Mehmet

title: US-06: As a student, I want to reserve a time slot for a lab device.
body:
**Epic:** E3 · **Points:** 8 · **Priority:** Must · **Dependencies:** US-02, US-11

**User story**
As a student, I want to reserve a time slot for a lab device.

**Acceptance criteria**
End before start → 400; overlaps a pending, approved or checked-in booking → 409; no valid lab approval → 403 LAB_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; no training authorization → 403 TRAINING_REQUIRED; on success 201 + PENDING.

**Owner:** Mürsel

**Definition of Done:** PR linked to this Issue (`Closes #...`), at least 1 approval, tests written, consistent with OpenAPI.

body:
**Epic:** E3 · **Points:** 5 · **Priority:** Must · **Dependencies:** US-06

**User story**
As a QA engineer, I want to verify the conflict engine and access rules with unit tests.

**Acceptance criteria**
Overlapping, nested and back-to-back ranges (10:00–11:00 and 11:00–12:00 do not conflict); all combinations of approval/authorization present or missing; M2 coverage at least 50%.

**Owner:** Mirac

**Definition of Done:** PR linked to this Issue (`Closes #...`), at least 1 approval, tests written, consistent with OpenAPI.

RESEARCH_ASSISTANT/ADMIN only; rejection reason required; only PENDING requests can be changed, otherwise 409; every transition is written to the status history.

title: US-17: As an instructor or research assistant, I want to define weekly office hours, support hours or training hours.
body:
**Epic:** E8 · **Points:** 5 · **Priority:** Must · **Dependencies:** US-02

**User story**
As an instructor or research assistant, I want to define weekly office hours, support hours or training hours.

**Acceptance criteria**
Type (OFFICE_HOUR, SUPPORT, TRAINING), day, time range and slot length are entered; category required for TRAINING; an instructor may define only OFFICE_HOUR, a research assistant only SUPPORT and TRAINING, otherwise 403; the system generates the slots; the same person's hours cannot overlap (409).
